Title: SetInteractable
Description: Set whether the currently iterated player in the interaction instruction should be able to interact with this NPC

Content.Description: Toggle whether the currently iterated player in the interaction instruction should be able to interact with this NPC
The interaction hint translation key to show for this player (e.g. 'interactionHints.trade')
Whether to show the F-key interaction prompt. Set to false for contextual-only interactions (e.g. shearing with tools). Defaults to true.
